cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Pass Me the Authority
cards.instruction: Get someone to transfer authority publicly by naming you as the person who decides what happens next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Hand me the hall key and tell everyone I'm now in charge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't I just give you the key? My retirement taxi's waiting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. The door will understand. The committee needs words.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're outside asking me whether to cancel Saturday's dance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell them I decide whether it goes ahead. Then ask me, in front of them. Your taxi can be my first approval.

mechanism: A claims authority in advance and grants B departure only after a public handover names A as the next decision maker.
confusable: D57 requests respect; D60 requires explicit public transfer of who decides subsequent business.
comparison: A retirement taxi and an urgent hall decision differ from a meeting chair correcting the audience of the handover.
seedUse: Retain D60-a physical key versus public committee instruction, including B actual pending dance decision.
